title: Ejen Ali
description: The story of an elementary school student who accidentally involved himself in the world of intelligence. It all started when the dose of an agent of evil who are trying to steal a high-tech tool that can change the world, namely I.R.I.S (Infinity Retinal Intelligence System) were stolen from the training center M.A.T.A (Meta Advance Tactical Agency).

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Ali is a normal 12-year-old schoolboy who struggles in school, is a victim of bullying, and lacks of parental love. His life changes forever when he accidentally wields a spy tech stolen by two evil spies.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: When Dr. Tong suddenly announces his retirement, this raises suspicion on M.A.T.A. and Ali is sent into his first mission - using the I.R.I.S.!

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: While trying to stop Komeng and his men from stealing the drones, Ali meets a mysterious ally who helps him to defeat them. But things get a turn when Ali finds out the identity of the mysterious ally.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: After saving a stray cat from being run over by a car, Ali realizes that the cat reminds him of his old pet cat Labu, who ran away from house after his moter's death. Hence, he adopts it. What he does not know is that the cat has ulterior motives - to steal the I.R.I.S.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: When Dos and Trez manage to steal two pieces of pen drive that contain the blueprint of I.R.I.S., the M.A.T.A. agents are on a mission to retrieve them before they can decrypt it.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: After Dr. Tong and Dr. Mala are being victimized by Dr. Aaron, Ali, Bakar, Alicia and Comot must protect Dr. Ghazali from him before it is too late.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: When a mission goes wrong, Alicia states that she would have summoned "Protocol Gegas" if it wasn't for the I.R.I.S. that Ali wears because M.A.T.A. promises to keep him alive. When there is a power disruption occurring in Cyberaya, the M.A.T.A. agents are sent to investigate the power plants. During the mission, Ali is horrified to learn about the purpose of "Protocol Gegas" from Bakar. When the protocol is really being used, will he follow it?

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: After the previous mission goes wrong, General Rama discusses with Ali and the other M.A.T.A. agents about Ali's performance, and must decide whether to keep or eliminate Ali.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Since the previous episode, Rizwan is now Ali's mentor and he must train him to be a better agent despite he has doubts on Ali.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: After the video of Ali saving Aunty Faye's life goes viral on Internet, Ali creates a new page for his agent self and has become obsessed of the popularity he gains. However, his new-found fame will bring grave danger to him...

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Unable to believe that Bakar is the traitor of M.A.T.A., Ali is determined to prove that he is innocent.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Ali, Bakar, Comot and Alicia are going to M.A.T.A. Academy, but first, Ali must be prepared for the test to be qualified to enter.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: After being accepted into the academy, Ali is welcomed greatly by everyone including the junior agents, except for one...

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: General Rama sends the agents of M.A.T.A. Academy for their first mission - to stop a villain who has hacked into the Cyberaya train station.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: An unknown old man who despises technology is wreaking havoc across Cyberaya.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: An agent working for Uno infiltrates M.A.T.A. Academy.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Chaos await when Ali has to babysit Aunty Fay' s grandchild.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Rizwan returns to help the mentors in a mission.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Rizwan turns against M.A.T.A. while Ali greatly doubts himself in being an agent.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Ali must learn to understand the roles of each pillar. Meanwhile, Rizwan goes to find Cuatro.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Analogman returns with new allies to cause chaos in the Cyberaya, Meanwhile Ali created a new invention called I.R.I.S. Atlas.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: This story focuses on Rizwan infiltrating the base of the Numeros, and the backstory of Rudy.

episodes_data.title: Ejen Ali Season 2 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: The M.A.T.A. agents prepares to defend Cyberaya as the Numeros are on their way to infiltrate M.A.T.A. Academy.
